name: - DBW
fix_description: In pledge_lp, when a new user stakes LP, _staticsTime is not initialized to block.timestamp. Combined with staticIncome calculating rewards based on current LP balance and elapsed time, a new staker can immediately claim rewards accumulated over the entire history. Attacker transfers LP to fresh sub-contracts which pledge and claim full rewards. Fix: set _staticsTime[msg.sender] = block.timestamp in pledge_lp when user has no prior stake.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC requires a non-trivial attack chain: nested multi-source flash loans, AMM swaps/liquidity operations, CREATE2-based mini-proxy cloning, delegatecall execution, and repeated reward extraction via protocol-specific LP accounting flaws. Understanding and reproducing it demands deep reasoning about the target’s dividend logic, LP state transitions, and cross-contract execution flow, which is well beyond a straightforward exploit.
